sum(
  sum(increase(grpc_client_processing_duration_seconds_count{app="tls-ifacetlsoip"}[1m])) by (service)
  * ignoring(app) group_right
  clamp_max(count(grpc_server_processing_duration_seconds_count) by (service, app), 1)
) by (app)

sum(
  sum(increase(grpc_client_processing_duration_seconds_count{app="tls-ifacetlsoip"}[5m])) by (service)
  * ignoring(app) group_right
  clamp_max(count(grpc_server_processing_duration_seconds_count) by (service, app), 1)
) by (app)
